content.short: Earn interest, borrow against your crypto, trade 100+ assets and spend with the Nexo Card from one wealth app.
content.description: Nexo has run since 2018 and keeps yield, credit and trading in one app. Deposits earn interest. Instant credit lines let users borrow cash or stablecoins against their crypto without selling it. The exchange covers more than 100 assets, and the Nexo Card pays with crypto and gives cashback. Nexo is a sponsor of the Australian Open and the DP World Tour, and runs separate services for US and UK customers. Savings come in flexible and fixed-term versions of up to 12 months, and the app adds dual investment, futures and a zero-interest credit option. Accounts above $100,000 get a dedicated relationship manager.
